settings.heading: CBG And CBD For Focus
settings.text:
We talk a lot about CBD here at HempLucid, and for good reason. In addition to helping us FIGHT STRESS and find DEEPER SLEEP (without next-day grogginess), CBD can help induce a state of relaxed calm that helps us feel sharp, clear, and “in the zone.” As the major non-intoxicating compound in cannabis and hemp, CBD is an all-natural all-star when it comes to helping us access better MENTAL CLARITY AND FOCUS.  


Then there’s CBG, another cannabinoid that’s attracting a lot of attention. Like CBD, CBG isn’t intoxicating, and it supports our health with anxiety-reducing, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective qualities. As THIS EARLY STUDY suggests, it’s an all-natural compound we’ll be hearing much, much more about in the years to come.

settings.heading: Mushrooms For Focus
settings.text:
As powerful as CBD and CBG are, they’re not the only compounds we lean on here at HempLucid. Since the earliest days of Chinese medicine, humans have known that adaptogens and functional mushrooms such as chaga have the potential to help us manage stress and achieve deeper focus without intoxication. And here at HempLucid, one of the mushrooms we lean most on is Lion’s Mane.  


In addition to promising data suggesting that Lion’s Mane can enhance the activities of neurotransmitters, Lion's Mane compounds have been shown to potentially INCREASE THE LEVELS OF NERVE GROWTH FACTOR (NGF) in the brain. NGF is a protein that plays an important role in the health of nerve cells, which is vital for cognitive function, memory, and concentration.

settings.title: CBD And CBN For Sleep
settings.content: CBD and CBN are naturally occurring cannabinoids found in hemp that interact with the body's endocannabinoid system (ECS), which helps regulate sleep, memory, immune function, and other essential processes. CBD may help promote more restful sleep by easing stress and anxiety, while CBN is known for its gentle, calming properties that may encourage relaxation without intoxication or grogginess. HempLucid's sleep formulas combine these cannabinoids to support healthy sleep and nighttime wellness. For those seeking a simple option, Water Soluble Sleep CBN pairs CBD and CBN with lavender and mint, while Sleep Mushroom Gummies and Sleep Stack Capsules add reishi mushrooms and other botanicals for more comprehensive sleep support.

settings.title: Reishi Mushrooms for Sleep
settings.content: Reishi (Ganoderma lucidum), often called the "mushroom of immortality," is a well-known adaptogenic mushroom traditionally used to support overall wellness and relaxation. Research suggests reishi may help improve sleep quality by increasing total sleep time and supporting the restorative stages of sleep. It may also help the body better manage stress by supporting healthy adrenal function and balancing stress hormones like cortisol and adrenaline. That's why HempLucid includes reishi in its Sleep Stack Capsules and Sleep Mushroom Gummies, combining it with other carefully selected ingredients to promote deeper, more restorative sleep.

settings.title: What's a Sleep Stack?
settings.answer: HempLucid’s Sleep gummies feature a carefully curated formulation of natural ingredients such as reishi mushrooms, CBN, L-theanine, magnesium, 5-HTP, and herbs—all selected by our master herbalist—that are geared to help you find deeper, more restorative sleep.

settings.title: Is CBN better than CBD for sleep?
settings.answer: Both CBD and CBN have been shown to potentially help us find deeper, more restorative sleep. That’s why we include both of these cannabinoids in our Sleep Mushroom Gummies. Many clinicians point to the “entourage effect,” a theory that suggests cannabinoids and other active compounds in cannabis plants act in partnership to elicit stronger effects. Still, some customers find that using just CBN for sleep suits their needs, so we offer Water Soluble Sleep CBN in a dreamy lavender mint flavor.

settings.title: Does CBD help with sleep?
settings.answer: A growing number of clinical studies show that CBD can reduce REM-related sleep disorders and tame excessive sleepiness the next day. Using CBD for sleep can also help reduce the anxiety that is a major contributor to insomnia, improving overall sleep quality and restfulness.

settings.title: What are the side effects of melatonin?
settings.answer: Common complaints after using melatonin include feelings of sleepiness or tiredness, headache, stomach ache, nausea, dizziness, irritability or restlessness, dry mouth, and dry or itchy skin. Many people wake with a feeling of grogginess after using melatonin. Because of these potential side effects, and because long-term studies on melatonin are lacking, we’ve elected to use all-natural ingredients such as CBD, CBN, reishi mushrooms and custom herbal blends instead.
